CPI account checks and ABI adapters for C and Rust VM instruction handling.

# Purpose
This file implements cross-program invocation support for the VM syscall layer. It contains the logic that prepares an instruction for execution in [`fd_vm_prepare_instruction`](<#fd_vm_prepare_instruction>), including account de-duplication, privilege normalization, signer checks, writable checks, program account lookup, and executable-account validation. It also defines helper functions and limits used by CPI processing, such as maximum signer count, maximum account info count, and maximum instruction data size.

The file then builds the CPI syscall implementation for two account and instruction ABIs: the C ABI and the Rust ABI. It uses macro-based code generation to map each ABI to the same shared implementation in `fd_vm_syscall_cpi_common.c`. These macro sets define how to read instruction fields, account metadata, and account data from VM memory for each ABI, including special handling for Rust `RefCell`-based account storage.
